manifest.name: v1-ridge-residual-head
manifest.description: V0 + per-platform additive ridge residual head over 8 input-only features (delta, delta*v, delta*|delta|, v_centered, a_long, delta_dot, v*delta_dot, |delta|*v). Coefficients fit on route-grouped 80/20 train/dev split. Tesla is V0 passthrough.
